episodes.title: Overture
episodes.summary: Charlie pitches Heaven her plan to save sinners by way of redeeming themselves through her Hotel. Vaggie enlists the staff to make a commercial to promote the hotel.

episodes.title: Radio Killed the Video Star
episodes.summary: The Vee's: Vox, Velvette, and Valentino rule their corner of Hell unchallenged, but Alastor's return to the airwaves may shake things up. Meanwhile, a new Hotel guest tests Angel's patience.

episodes.title: Scrambled Eggs
episodes.summary: While the Hotel's guests and crew spend the day learning about trust, information revealed at a meeting of overlords leads to a respectless dispute.

episodes.title: Masquerade
episodes.summary: Angel struggles to juggle his work and his time at the Hotel. Charlie decides it's time to put her ‘Princess' status to use with Angel's boss.

episodes.title: Dad Beat Dad
episodes.summary: Charlie struggles with asking her father, Lucifer, for help. Meanwhile, an unexpected new arrival shakes things up at the Hotel.

episodes.title: Welcome to Heaven
episodes.summary: Charlie and Vaggie make their way to Heaven to speak to Adam's manager. Meanwhile an explosive reunion gives Angel the opportunity to show how far he's come.

episodes.title: Hello Rosie!
episodes.summary: With secrets revealed and the Hotel in the crosshairs, Charlie and Vaggie must do what they can to protect their home from destruction by any means necessary.

episodes.title: The Show Must Go On
episodes.summary: In the Season One finale, all bets are off as the confrontation between the legions of Heaven and Hell begins.

episodes.title: New Pentious
episodes.summary: Charlie's victory against Heaven has sinners flocking to the newly rebuilt Hazbin Hotel. But can she make sure they're all there for the right reasons? Meanwhile, Vox reveals his plan for the Vees to gain their ultimate victory.

episodes.title: Storyteller
episodes.summary: Sir Pentious' redemption creates a stir in Heaven, but not everyone is happy to see a sinner redeemed.

episodes.title: Hazbin Hotel: Behind Closed Doors
episodes.summary: Charlie invites Voxtek to do a piece on the Hotel and Pentious' redemption. But she will need hard proof to convince her skeptical guests.

episodes.title: It's A Deal
episodes.summary: Charlie tries to do damage control by going live on television! Meanwhile, Alastor reaches his final straw.

episodes.title: Silenced
episodes.summary: Vox hosts a rally for his increasing supporters. Meanwhile, Charlie looks to Heaven for help.

episodes.title: Scream Rain
episodes.summary: Vox leads the overlords toward war with Heaven. Tensions run high at the hotel and Husk returns to his old ways.

episodes.title: Weapon of Mass Distraction
episodes.summary: Vox unveils his secret weapon, giving Heaven their final warning.

episodes.title: Curtain Call
episodes.summary: Vox (and the Vees, I guess) is hosting a party so everyone can watch him take over Heaven - and you're all invited!
